scope: New grammar-assisted review of eight named remaining Chamorro draft values only, not full catalogue re-audit

source.author: Sandra Chung
read_sections: selected tulaika/nahung lexical examples, not entire grammar

rows.reason: Supported bounded composition. Current own ui_menu_edit=Tulaika, supported also Chung change examples; bare transitive imperative §15.2.1. gi locative plus proper mode name Paint. Actual AssemblyActivity88 requestOutput(true) transfers output for editing. Does not promise source overwrite.

rows.draft: Baba i påhinan pinenta fine'na, despues patcha Usa i pinenta.
rows.proposed: Baba i påhinan pinenta fine'na, despues patcha Usa i pinenta.
rows.reason: Supported bounded composition. Own formats22_open_page=Baba i påhina, ui_add_images_first establishes fine’na, existing commands use patcha, and gallery_use_image exactly Usa i pinenta. Complete sequence matches MediaGalleryActivity168/343/349. Chung §15.2.1 supports bare active imperatives; §7.2 linker -n after vowel supports påhinan pinenta. No new technical noun. Retains original draft spelling/sequence rather than global normalization.

rows.draft: %1$s: ti nahong i memoria para i mostra-ña.
rows.proposed: %1$s: ti nahung i RAM para i mostra-ña.
rows.reason: Support revised full value only: current own repeated Ti nahung i RAM para... supplies technical-memory sense rather than unverified memoria; ui_preview=Mostra. Chung §7.2 third-singular possessive -ña supports its preview, including inanimate antecedent. Placeholder remains image identifier. Exact-key scan found no current main Kotlin consumer; canonical-only, not claimed user-facing improvement.

Hold pending apply/use relation review. Grammar establishes Usa is possible imperative, not that Usa para todu unambiguously means apply current transformation to every image. Existing ui_apply=Cho'gui and crop/bounds use Usa with explicit direct object; do not infer relational construction from morphology alone.

rows.draft: Usa para este siha na pinenta
rows.reason: Hold for same apply-to relation. Chung attests esti siha na noun (example17.5(23)), but establishes plural demonstrative construction only, not missing applied-object role. Existing este/esti differences not automatically errors.

rows.draft: Na'ta'lu i orihinåt na mineddung siha
rows.reason: Hold. Draft Na'ta'lu is not validated as restore-original-state by grammar; na' productive causative plus ta'lu again is insufficient lexical/action evidence. Existing recovered-copy reopening donor does not describe dimension reset. Original/mineddung nouns alone cannot close this gap.

rows.draft: Na'arekla i pinenta siha sigun i na'an i dokumentu pat i oran tinilaika
rows.reason: Hold. Grammar helps noun linking and plural siha, but Na'arekla must specifically order/sort and oran tinilaika must mean modification timestamp rather than duration. No whole construction established in inspected source. Do not import generic arrange/change as proven technical sort.

rows.draft: Ti nahong i memoria para u ma'atan i pinentan galeria.
rows.reason: Hold original. Technical memoria not independently established; RAM donor can fix that but ma'atan viewing is not necessarily inspection/processing in actual download/decode/credit pipeline OOM. Need defensible inspect term/full clause, not grammar alone.

limits: Three supported whole-value candidates require parent independent review before integration
Grammar does not establish technical nouns or legal meanings
Preserve Guam/CNMI variants; no blanket spelling normalization
Preview resource canonical-only; do not count it as a newly reachable UI control
excluded: Existing ui_add_images not counted; obsolete attachment-specific not-placed draft not accepted
